lastCompletedStory.title: Wire the sidecar report pusher to sendKeysVerified

nextStoryContext: All 3 stories in this PRD (US-001, US-002, US-003 / CAM-200) now pass. US-003 rewired makeNotifyOrchestrator (src/supervisor/host.ts) to push through US-002's sendKeysVerified instead of a bare fire-and-forget spawnFn tmux send-keys call, giving worker/sidecar completion narration idle-gate + composer-emptied delivery verify + bounded retry (default maxAttempts=3). Signature is now (sessionName, spawnFn, capturePaneFn?, logEvent?): two new helpers ship alongside it in host.ts -- makeCapturePaneFn(spawnFn) builds a bare capture-pane reader for callers that only have a raw spawnFn (used by the 3 sidecar.ts call-sites, each building a fresh one per call-site: makeProductionMergeWatchFn ~L765, makeProductionShipPhaseFn ~L1155, runPostPlanActions ~L2093), and adaptLogEventForPush(logEvent: WorkerEventLogger) downcasts the full event-object logger to the bare (kind, detail) seam sendKeysVerified expects, fixing uuid:'sidecar'/storyId:undefined. host.ts's own call-site (buildSupervisorOptions) reuses its existing real capturePane closure + logEvent directly. On retry exhaustion only a 'push-undelivered' event fires (no new durable marker, per AC4); getOrchPaneId resolution + silent no-op on a closed orch pane are unchanged. Updated 3 pre-existing test files (host-notify-orch.test.ts, single-pusher-guard.test.ts, integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts) that broke under the new idle-gate+verify behavior -- see the patterns.md bullet for the real-tmux fixture gotcha (a raw `cat` pane never shows a claude-style prompt, so the idle-gate polls the full 5s timeout unless primed; pane height must stay small (<=5) so the primed '>' line stays inside isOrchPaneIdle's tail-5-lines window instead of being pushed out by blank filler rows). Added a new describe block to notify-orchestrator.test.ts with 3 tests (retry-then-delivered, retry-exhausted-then-push-undelivered, adaptLogEventForPush wiring) satisfying AC5's oracle. File-size ceilings raised (tracker ref CAM-200 staged): src/supervisor/host.ts 889->959, src/commands/sidecar.ts 2810->2840, test/supervisor/host-notify-orch.test.ts 125->133, test/integration/review-verdict-handback.test.ts 136->157, test/supervisor/notify-orchestrator.test.ts 248->374. No new external lib touched (pure internal TS/tmux wiring). This PRD is now fully complete: the supervisor's decideNextAction should route to review next (no further implement dispatch expected on this branch).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal wiring of makeNotifyOrchestrator to the already-existing sendKeysVerified (src/tmux/dispatch.ts, US-002); no new external library/API surface introduced. Only stdlib (node:child_process types) and existing project modules (events.ts, session.ts) are touched.
